name: Toronto City Hall
scope: Toronto City Hall at Nathan Phillips Square as seen in April 2018, including the two curved office towers, council chamber, podium and ceremonial approach.

stories.title: Toronto City Hall: The Building That Was Almost Thrown Away

originalReview.notes: The April 2018 original shows the two asymmetric curved towers, curved glazing, blank ribbed concrete, the curved white roof of the council chamber, podium paving and the entrance ramp.

review.method: Exact Qualla original and named native public-domain release
review.notes: The April 2018 image by Daniel Lobo exactly matches the public Qualla file. The original Flickr URL is identified by the Commons record, which records an independent CC0 Flickr review. The second Qualla image depicts bike sharing and was excluded from exterior references.
